% Synthetic adapter fixture. No uploaded CV, personal data, or production template.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{luacode}
\begin{document}
\begin{luacode*}
local data = dofile(os.getenv('CV_DATA_FILE'))
local replacements = {
  ['\\'] = '\\textbackslash{}', ['{'] = '\\{', ['}'] = '\\}',
  ['#'] = '\\#', ['$'] = '\\$', ['%'] = '\\%', ['&'] = '\\&',
  ['_'] = '\\_', ['~'] = '\\textasciitilde{}', ['^'] = '\\textasciicircum{}',
}
local function text(value)
  return tostring(value or ''):gsub('.', function(character)
    return replacements[character] or character
  end)
end
tex.print(text(data.person.displayName) .. '\\par')
if data.person.role then tex.print(text(data.person.role) .. '\\par') end
for _, section in ipairs(data.sections) do
  if #section.entries > 0 then tex.print('\\section*{' .. text(section.label) .. '}') end
  for _, entry in ipairs(section.entries) do
    tex.print(text(entry.fields.title) .. ' ' .. text(entry.fields.organization) .. ' ' .. text(entry.fields.period) .. '\\par')
    for _, block in ipairs(entry.content) do
      if block.type == 'paragraph' then
        tex.print(text(block.text) .. '\\par')
      elseif block.type == 'bulletList' then
        tex.print('\\begin{itemize}')
        for _, item in ipairs(block.items) do tex.print('\\item ' .. text(item.text)) end
        tex.print('\\end{itemize}')
      end
    end
  end
end
\end{luacode*}
\end{document}
